create_sparse_linearization: create a SparseLinearization instance from an Objective with optional VariableOrdering
linearize_jacobian: call _linearize_jacobian_impl to compute sparse Jacobian A_val and residual b tensors
compute_At_b: call _atb_impl to lazily compute the transpose of A multiplied by b vector
multiply_Av: call Av to compute the sparse matrix-vector product of A with vector v
diagonal_scaling: call diagonal_scaling to compute the diagonal of AtA scaled by vector v
